help.title: help centre
help.intro: Quick answers. If you're stuck, Support chat is one tap away.
help.q1: How do I install my eSIM?
help.a1: Open your eSIM in the app and tap Install on this phone. On another phone, scan the QR code under Settings › Mobile › Add eSIM. Install it before you fly while you have Wi-Fi.
help.a2: Most plans start when your phone first connects to a network at your destination. The plan page says if a plan starts when you install it instead.
help.q3: How do I turn it on when I land?
help.a3: Turn on the vela line in Settings › Mobile and switch on data roaming for it. Keep your home SIM for calls and texts if you like.
help.q4: How much data do I have left?
help.a4: Open the eSIM in the app to see what's left and your daily use. Figures can lag by a couple of hours behind the network.
help.a5: Yes. Tap Top up on the eSIM. The data, and any extra days, are added to the same eSIM, so there's nothing to reinstall.
help.a6: If you haven't installed the eSIM, contact us within 30 days of purchase for a full refund. After installation we refund only if it doesn't work because of a fault on our side. If we can't issue your eSIM, you're refunded automatically.
help.q7: Can I move my eSIM to a new phone?
help.a7: Usually not. An installed eSIM stays on the phone it was installed on, so install it on the phone you'll travel with.
help.q8: Do I get a phone number?
help.a8: No. vela plans are data only. Use WhatsApp, FaceTime or similar apps for calls, and keep your home number active on your other line.
help.contact: Still need help? Open Support chat.

compatibility.title: device compatibility
compatibility.intro: vela works on phones that support eSIM and aren't locked to a carrier.
compatibility.checkBody: Dial *#06#. If you see an EID number, your phone supports eSIM.
compatibility.iphoneBody: iPhone XS, XS Max, XR and every newer model, including iPhone SE (2nd generation and later). iPhones bought in mainland China, Hong Kong or Macau may not support eSIM.
compatibility.androidBody: Google Pixel 3 and later (not Pixel 3a bought in Japan), Samsung Galaxy S20 and later, Z Flip and Z Fold, and recent models from Motorola, OnePlus, Xiaomi, OPPO and others. Check your model's settings for Add eSIM.
compatibility.unlockedBody: If your phone came from a carrier on contract, ask them to unlock it before you travel. A locked phone can't use another provider's eSIM.
compatibility.settingsBody: iPhone: Settings › Mobile (or Cellular) › Add eSIM. Android: Settings › Network & internet › SIMs › Add eSIM.
